description: EU country economic snapshot (Eurostat) — Latest official Eurostat macro picture for an EU/EEA country, the euro area or the EU-27 in one call: HICP inflation (headline + food, previous month, year ago), unemployment (incl. youth, year-ago change), real GDP growth (y/y and q/q, last 5 quarters) and government debt % of GDP, plus plain-English signals and a status (STABLE / SOFTENING / CONTRACTING / OVERHEATING). Params: country (required: ISO2 such as DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, PL; Greece = EL or GR; EA = euro area; EU = EU-27; country names also work). Source: Eurostat (free re-use, attribution included). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: econ_eu_snapshot
